name: sonic_damage32
prompt: Use case precise-object-edit. Production DAMAGE STATE / MODULAR BREAKUP kit for this EXACT sonic tank. Preserve every part's original overhead view, down facing, palette, bolts, shape and scale. No new tank design. True transparent RGBA and no haze/backdrop. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS by EIGHT ROWS,32 separate cells, wide transparent gutters. ROW1 bare hull (NO TRACKS/WEAPONS); ROW2 main weapon assembly; ROW3 left track; ROW4 right track; ROW5 auxiliary side pod; ROW6 rear reactor; ROW7 sensor. In each of these7 rows: COLUMN1 lightly damaged scraped armor and few bullet dents; COLUMN2 critically damaged cracked armor/exposed wiring/metal; COLUMN3 a fully broken charred wreck of that same module with torn steel and small anchored flames; COLUMN4 solid WHITE silhouette hit-flash frame of that exact module (opaque white where module was, transparent elsewhere). Each row uses ONLY that isolated part, not assembled tank. Row8 is four isolated heavy debris pieces from tank's armor/tread/turret/reactor, different shapes, no explosions. Frames must have stable mounts and same scale within each row so intact can swap to damage and still fit. Keep complete silhouette, no clipping into other cells. Detailed Neo Geo arcade pixels. No words, no numbers.
